title: Field UI redesign and 0.5 km well search
notes: The default nearby well search radius is now 0.5 km, with 1, 2, 5, 10 km and Exact LSD available beside it.
Reworked the mobile Wells screen into a clearer search-area selector, well filter, pin toggle, live-data source badge, and cleaner result cards.
Renamed Job History to Saved LSDs so the interface matches the new one-record-per-LSD behaviour.
Saved LSDs now show a record count and the active LSD panel shows previous search date and search count when available.
Refined the map search, top bar, bottom navigation, cards, buttons, spacing, shadows, and mobile bottom sheets for faster one-hand field use.
The well data source remains explicit: live AER OneStop online with the automatically refreshed ST37 data as offline fallback.
